panels.title: Agent step distribution
panels.description: How many steps (node invocations) each agent run took before completing or being terminated. Counts traces from cpie.agent_traces grouped by total steps per trace_id.

targets.rawSql: SELECT steps, COUNT(*) AS runs FROM (SELECT trace_id, MAX(step_no) AS steps FROM cpie.agent_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY trace_id) sub GROUP BY steps ORDER BY steps

panels.title: Termination reason breakdown
panels.description: Fraction of agent runs that ended with each termination reason: complete | max_steps | max_cost | max_time | fallback_to_fast. Drawn from the final step per trace where termination_reason is set.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(termination_reason, 'unknown') AS reason, COUNT(DISTINCT trace_id) AS runs FROM cpie.agent_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND termination_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reason ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Per-node latency (mean ms)
panels.description: Mean latency in milliseconds per workflow node across all agent traces in the time window. Nodes: planner, retriever, grader, retry_retriever, claim_builder, verifier, synthesiser.

targets.rawSql: SELECT node_name, ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)) AS mean_latency_ms FROM cpie.agent_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY node_name ORDER BY mean_latency_ms DESC

panels.title: Coverage retry rate (%)
panels.description: Percentage of agent runs where at least one retry_retriever node was invoked — indicating a sub-question had a coverage gap that triggered a retry.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT retry_traces.trace_id)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT all_traces.trace_id), 0) AS retry_pct FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trace_id FROM cpie.agent_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)) AS all_traces LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT trace_id FROM cpie.agent_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND node_name = 'retry_retriever') AS retry_traces ON all_traces.trace_id = retry_traces.trace_id

panels.title: Mean cost per complex query (USD)
panels.description: Mean total cost_usd summed across all steps per trace_id, for agent traces in the time window. Reflects actual LLM spend per agent-routed query.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(trace_cost) AS mean_cost_usd FROM (SELECT trace_id, SUM(cost_usd) AS trace_cost FROM cpie.agent_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trace_id) sub
